WITH album_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AlbumId,
    COUNT(*) as track_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / Milliseconds END) as album_rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(album_rate) as mean_val
  FROM album_stats
)
SELECT 
  AVG(a.album_rate) as avg_rate,
  AVG(a.track_count) as avg_track_count,
  AVG(a.album_rate - m.mean_val) as avg_excess
FROM album_stats a
CROSS JOIN mean_rate m
WHERE a.album_rate > m.mean_val
